title: OpenPlow finding
description: A single candidate vulnerability produced by a hunter and judged by the validator. Adapted from the Cloudflare security-audit skill's report schema.

id.description: Stable cross-run key for this finding (root-cause based, not line based).

verdict.description: confirmed = complete source trace + bounded observed result; needs_validation = exact unresolved fact, no severity; rejected = disproved.

attack_class.description: One of the attack classes from the skill's class files (e.g. web-auth, memory-safety, llm, supply-chain).

weakness.description: The hunter's own label for the weakness (e.g. 'OS command injection (CWE-78)'). attack_class is the hunt cell's class.

severity.description: Impact = likelihood x impact. Null unless verdict is confirmed.

attacker.description: Who the attacker is and what they control.

poc.description: A proof of concept that runs against the UNTOUCHED codebase. Absent/failing PoC => finding is treated as fake.

observed.description: The bounded result observed when run.

patch.description: Proposed git diff that fixes the finding.

validation.description: Filled by the adversarial validator; never by the finder.
